send_line: People forward this because everyone has stood at a paint shop's colour-mixing machine, and nobody knows it turned up in a court case.

beats.say: Asian Paints calls its network one of its strongest advantages.
beats.caption: 'One of our strongest'

beats.link: THEREFORE (to judge it, look at how it sells)
beats.say: Still a moat? A new rival says it invests aggressively.
beats.caption: Rival: 'invest aggressively'

beats.say: Asian Paints sells almost all to dealers and distributors. The ten biggest take under one rupee in a hundred.
beats.caption: Top 10: 0.9%

beats.link: THEREFORE (that is what the rival did)
beats.say: So rivals must win them shop by shop.
beats.caption: Shop by shop
beats.label: OUR READING
beats.source: Our reading of Asian Paints IAR 2025-26

beats.link: BUT (that machine is now in court)
beats.say: Grasim says its Birla Opus has over fifty thousand dealers, with compact tinting machines.
beats.caption: 50,000+ dealers · Grasim says

beats.say: But that machine has ended up in a court judgment.
beats.caption: In a court judgment

beats.link: BUT (an allegation is not a finding)
beats.say: Grasim alleged Asian Paints directed dealers to return it, or not install it.
beats.caption: Allegation only

beats.say: The regulator's probe order, the court notes, is merely a prima facie opinion.
beats.caption: 'Merely a prima facie opinion'

beats.say: Still a moat? Even Grasim's report says challengers with distribution depth gain most.
beats.caption: Brand · capacity · distribution depth

beats.say: So the counter is still the prize. Which is why
beats.caption: The counter
beats.label: OUR READING; 'counter' is a metaphor from Asian Paints' 'counter share'

title: Asian Paints' strongest edge has a catch
